Resolves #20033

`WorkstationMaximizeOverflowMenuNL` now compares the overflow partition the menu opened against, once the DOM shows it. The old snapshot was taken before clicking More tabs and was gated on the plugin's worker flags only. Under load, two windows broke it. Both were measured at 6× CPU throttle; #20033's corrected body has the derivation.

- **(A)** The DOM lags the published split: `appliedHiddenIds` is published before the same pass's header updates land. This is the specimen's signature.
- **(B)** The revealed focus-gated actions report their width through their own `resize` events. Those can arrive after the idle gate and re-partition the closed strip, so the menu opens with one item more than the snapshot.

`waitForOverflowSettled` now also waits until the DOM shows `appliedHiddenIds` (A). The partition snapshot moves to after the menu is visible (B), since an open menu parks every projection. The action ids stay compared with the pre-click read. Spec-only.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium, Brain-gated whitebox e2e; CI's full `e2e-brain` tier runs the spec) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2). AC-3 is the cut-record disposition.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** Ticket `#20033` (including its 6× CPU-throttled derivation of Mechanisms A and B), changed-file list (`test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationMaximizeOverflowMenuNL.spec.mjs`), current `dev` source of `WorkstationMaximizeOverflowMenuNL.spec.mjs:55-198`, and `src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs:988-1231` (`applySplit`, `restoreOpenMenuPartition`, `observeMenuListLifecycle`, `queueOpenMenuProjection`, `drainOpenMenuProjection`).
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** `waitForOverflowSettled` must verify that the main-thread DOM reflects `appliedHiddenIds` (hidden buttons have no client rects; non-hidden buttons have client rects), and `assertOverflowMenuHoldsAndSelects` must snapshot the header partition (`openHiddenIds`, `openVisibleHeaders`) once the overflow menu is open (where `Overflow#queueOpenMenuProjection` parks further projections), while still capturing `preActionIds` before clicking the overflow control so any focus loss during the menu open/hold window is caught. It must NOT weaken the `#19984` `DomAccess#getClippedRect` regression witness during the 350 ms hold window.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches the expected shape. `waitForOverflowSettled(page, app, chrome)` checks `(document.getElementById(id)?.getClientRects().length > 0) !== hiddenIds.includes(id)` across all `chrome.buttons`, and `assertOverflowMenuHoldsAndSelects` captures `preActionIds` before `overflowControl.click()`, waits for `menuList` to open (`toHaveCount(1)`), snapshots `openHiddenIds` and `openVisibleHeaders` via `waitForOverflowSettled`, holds for `350 ms`, and asserts both menu geometry/focus and partition/action stability.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with `verify-before-assert`: instead of assuming a single worker-to-DOM race from static inspection, 6× CPU-throttled runs falsified the initial single-cause hypothesis (14/18 runs failed on Mechanism B vs 1/18 on Mechanism A) and proved that reversing `#19984` still fails 2/2 at head.
